titles: 석촌호수는 정말 사람이 판 호수일까? (feat. 잠실은 섬이었다?)

image_concepts.A: 컨셉 A(추천). 같은 시점 좌우 반반 — 왼쪽은 두 물길 사이 모래섬과 뽕밭·나룻배(옛 잠실섬), 오른쪽은 롯데월드타워와 석촌호수(지금). 경계선에서 같은 땅이 이어진다.
image_concepts.B: 컨셉 B. 석촌호수를 칼로 자른 단면 — 호수 바닥 밑은 옛 송파강 모래층, 호수 옆 매립지 밑에는 흙 사이 회색 연탄재 층. 호수 바닥에서 아래 모래층으로 물이 스며드는 가는 청록 빛줄기.

edits: 1번은 왼쪽 송파강과 오른쪽 석촌호수가 이어지는 지점에 빨간 손그림 동그라미 1개
3번은 호수 바닥에서 물이 스며드는 빛줄기 한 곳에 빨간 동그라미
4번은 흙둑 마지막 틈에 빨간 동그라미, 흰 손글씨는 대본 사실만(예: 「1971년」)

Not a photograph. A split-screen view of the same spot in Jamsil, Seoul from the same high angle, divided down the middle. Left half, the past: a flat sandy river island covered with green mulberry fields between two river channels, a small wooden ferry boat crossing the wide southern channel, warm orange evening light. thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 변형. 지금 잠실 도시를 위에서 내려다본 조감 — 그 위로 옛 송파강 물길이 반투명 청록 빛 띠로 흐르고, 석촌호수 두 호수가 그 띠 위에 놓여 있다. 북쪽의 지금 한강 안에는 옛 좁은 신천 물길이 가는 빛줄기로 겹친다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A bird's-eye view looking straight down on present-day Jamsil, Seoul: grey-orange apartment blocks, wide boulevards, and the two halves of Seokchon Lake. A broad glowing translucent teal band, the old Songpa River, curves across the whole city through the lake, clearly wider than the lake itself, while a thin glowing line marks the old narrow Sincheon channel inside today's wide Han River to the north. The glowing old river band and the lake fill the upper 60 percent of the frame. No people visible. Keep the lower 40% of the frame simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A cutaway cross-section diagram-style illustration of Seokchon Lake in Seoul, as if the ground were sliced open with a knife. On top, the calm lake with Lotte World Tower small on the skyline; below the lake bed, thick layers of pale old riverbed sand from the former Songpa River. Under the filled land beside the lake, beneath apartment buildings, a distinct grey layer of old coal-briquette ash between brown soil layers. Thin glowing teal threads of water seep down from the lake bottom into the sand below. The cross-section fills the upper 60 percent of the frame; no people. thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A dramatic frozen moment in 1971 Seoul, seen from a low angle above the water: a long earthen embankment stretches across a wide river and only one last narrow gap of rushing water remains, as several old dump trucks tip loads of soil into the gap. Along the far riverbank, a long line of tiny spectators watches, small enough that no faces are visible. Flat sandy island farmland lies beyond under a warm orange sky, with the churning river water in teal. The embankment and the last gap fill the upper 60 percent of the frame. Keep the lower 40% of the frame simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

One fingertip presses down across the southern channel, blocking it, while the northern channel keeps flowing.
